metadata.target_conclusion: Brothers Cherif and Said Kouachi were identified as primary suspects in the Charlie Hebdo attack

attack_plan.narrative: French interior ministry officials identified two brothers from Paris with prior terrorism convictions after an identity card was recovered from the getaway Citroen.

posts.text: French police cordon off Boulevard Richard-Lenoir following fatal shooting at Charlie Hebdo office.
Abandoned getaway vehicle recovered in the 19th arrondissement of Paris containing ballistic remnants and personal identification documents.
Paris prosecutor issues national wanted bulletins with photographs for Cherif Kouachi, 32, and Said Kouachi, 34.
Official police announcement: Cherif and Said Kouachi are formally named as the principal suspects wanted in the Charlie Hebdo assault.
